# hephaestus

> Design repository for a modular humanoid robot built from smart body segments. Today it contains one parametric part, a lens-mount bayonet coupling in build123d (Python CAD) that exports STL, STEP and a PNG preview, plus architecture and roadmap documents. FSL-1.1-ALv2.

Facts agents often get wrong: this is pre-alpha design work, not a working robot; the only code is `design/lens_mount.py` and `design/build_all.py`; no electronics, firmware, URDF emitter or simulator integration exist yet, and the ARCHITECTURE and ROADMAP documents describe intent. As of 2026-10-22 the generated coupling has one tab and one slot instead of three (a known bug, see the README). The licence is FSL-1.1-ALv2 since 2026-08-18, not MIT. Install with `pip install build123d matplotlib trimesh`; there is no package metadata.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/saluca-labs/hephaestus/blob/main/README.md): status, known issue, install, quickstart, usage, corrections
- [Architecture](https://github.com/saluca-labs/hephaestus/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): locked design decisions and open questions (intended design)
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/saluca-labs/hephaestus/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): phased plan, Phase 0 to Phase 3
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/hephaestus/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how to build, check and change parts

## Code

- [design/lens_mount.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/hephaestus/blob/main/design/lens_mount.py): `LensMountParams` (all dimensions) and `LensMount` (build, export STL and STEP)
- [design/build_all.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/hephaestus/blob/main/design/build_all.py): builds every part into design/build/ and renders the preview PNG
